name: TW Post Modifier Tracker
author: Technology Wisdom

sections.description:
TW Post Modifier Tracker is a lightweight plugin that helps editorial teams, site managers, and content creators track content updates.
It adds a new column to the WordPress Posts, Pages, WooCommerce Products, and Custom Post Types admin lists, showing the date/time of the last modification and the user who made the change, with no configuration needed.

Whether you’re managing a multi author site or auditing content activity, this plugin gives you clear visibility into post updates at a glance.

Features:

  • Adds a “Last Modified” column to the admin list table for posts, pages, products, and custom post types
  • Shows the exact date and time a post was last updated
  • Displays the user who last modified the content
  • Seamlessly integrates with the WordPress admin interface
  • No configuration required, Just install and activate
  • Includes a built-in tutorial page under Settings → Tutorial (TW PMT) with video guidance

Privacy / External Service

This plugin can optionally connect to an external support service operated by Technology Wisdom.

Service: https://pluginsupport.technologywisdom.com

Terms of Use: https://pluginsupport.technologywisdom.com/terms-of-use/

Privacy Policy: https://pluginsupport.technologywisdom.com/privacy-policy/

The service is used to provide in-plugin support messaging, feedback forwarding, and announcements.

Opt-in consent (required before any connection):

When you activate the plugin, an admin notice asks whether you want to allow the support connection. You can choose Allow Support Connection or No Thanks.

  • If you allow the connection, the plugin may send: site URL, site name, admin email, plugin name/version, WordPress version, and PHP version. Support requests and review/feedback details are sent only when you submit those forms. The plugin may also check weekly for announcements from Technology Wisdom.
  • If you decline (or never accept), that data is not sent to the support portal. The plugin’s core feature continues to work normally without the connection.
  • You are never required to allow the connection to use the plugin.
  • You can disconnect the support connection at any time from the plugin’s Support page by choosing Disable priority support.

Support and rating forms also include their own consent checkboxes before site information is included with a submission.

Please review the service Terms of Use and Privacy Policy before enabling the connection.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it via the WordPress plugin dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Navigate to Posts, Pages, or any public WooCommerce Products/Custom Post Type in your WordPress admin.
  4. Look for the new Last Modified column, that’s it!
sections.faq:
Does this work with custom post types and WooCommerce Products?

Yes, it works with all public Custom Post Types and WooCommerce Products that support the admin UI.

Who is this plugin for?

Bloggers, editors, content managers, developers, anyone who needs to track post activity and authorship.

Will it impact performance?

No, it won’t. This is a simple, lightweight plugin that has minimal impact on your site.

Where can I view a tutorial?

You’ll find a full usage tutorial under Settings → Tutorial (TW PMT).

What timezone does the plugin use?

The plugin follows the timezone set in your WordPress settings.

Why does it show Last Modified by Unknown?

If you see Last Modified by Unknown, it means the page has not been edited since the plugin was activated. Once the page is updated after activation, the plugin will capture and display the name of the user who last modified the page.
